delivery.intended_path: agents/config.example.json for both RCA and Report
delivery.note: D02, D03, D06, D09 and D10 use reviewed source observation contracts with MCP datasource/cluster-label discovery and request cluster_id. Other 40 bindings remain candidates. Discovery does not attest arbitrary producer versions, current health, causal conclusions, or full-window retention.

provenance.json_field_names: Implementation proposal; the source MD specifies semantics, not these literal field names.

fleet_intelligence.note: Verify original Fleet names against names stored through OTel; never infer case conversion.

nvidia_dcgm_exporter.note: Verify exporter collection settings and device support separately from DCGM catalog availability.

kube_state_metrics.note: Verify allowlists, forwarded series, UID labels and resource/unit labels.

scrape_collector.note: up and scrape_duration_seconds describe scrape targets, not GPU device counts.

effective_request_producer.note: Preserve D07 producer validity; raw KSM D21 requests are not a replacement.

workload_log_producer.note: D13 producer and workload filters remain unresolved; do not merge with Fleet D09.

binding_policy.not_applicable_rule: sample_interval/max_hold/invalid_values/counter_reset may declare not_applicable only with a reviewed reason and evidence; null is never verified
binding_policy.scope_requirement: environment.scope_labels mapping of request cluster_id; legacy literal environment.cluster_id remains supported
binding_policy.datasource_requirement: pinned datasource_uid or explicit discover mode with null UID and approved cluster label names

D05.preserve: health parser, required facts, producer, freshness, source-position and evidence references

D08.preserve: observed GPU-Pod labels joined with D06 UID and valid time

before_consolidating: preserve each consumer authorized target arguments
transition.dedicated_allocation_override: Keep its old profile or define a separately reviewed allocation D before migration; never replace it with observed GPU_UTIL labels.
transition.historical_evidence: Preserve old query IDs, versions, snapshots, hashes and published Runbook revisions without rewriting.
transition.old_jobs: Remain pinned to the old profile and compatible Worker until drained; do not execute retired IDs via this new default registry.
transition.runbook_transition: Review the 267 authored sources and applicable published revisions; preserve required health facts, authoring compatibility and investigation-only status. Publish a new revision only through the existing workflow.

consumer_invariants.shared_profile: RCA and Report load this same profile; RCA Runbook query IDs and required facts resolve through the shared registry.
consumer_invariants.fact_support: Binding verification alone does not establish fact support; the registered parser/calculation and consumer must support the requested fact.
d02_outputs: observed connection labels; zero activity remains a valid observation
consumer_invariants.d02_pod_join: D06 UID and valid-time agreement required; never infer exclusive allocation or MIG allocation from utilization.
consumer_invariants.d09_health: Use fleet-component-log-v1; missing producer, source time or freshness never becomes a valid state fact.
consumer_invariants.d14: Product DB context only; not an external query or binding.
consumer_invariants.selection: Only O/Runbook-selected queries and bounded dependencies; do not query all catalog entries.
consumer_invariants.failure_isolation: Unavailable optional inputs block only dependent new outputs; preserve independent existing calculations.
consumer_invariants.scope: Never widen to an entire cluster when authorized entity projection is unavailable.
consumer_invariants.calculation: Deterministic registered code; preserve empty/failure/zero distinctions; no LLM arithmetic or data invention.
non_equivalence: D07 effective requests != D21 raw requests
D11 energy integral and D49 counter delta must not be double-counted
ECC device/total and volatile/aggregate must not be blindly summed

catalog_dispositions.scope: All identifiers in mapping section 9, not an inventory of all deployed metrics
